与职场生活一起成长(Growing up with work life): 一篇关于职场工作的B1记叙文:莉莉的经历、感受与成长。

Lily is saving money to buy a ticket to Chengdu. On Sunday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. The work station looked quieter than usual that evening. For example, the vet checked the puppy's ears.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Lily thanked Nina for the honest advice. Lily wrote down every idea in a small notebook. In fact, the old coaching inn at Royston serves a famous Sunday roast.

The experience taught Lily more than any book could. The front desk has become an important part of daily life. Lily's dream job is to be a cook. In fact, faking safety logs counts as gross misconduct.

Lily prefers sunny weather when running in the library. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. People around Lily often share different ideas about the work station. Machines have reduced hard labour on farms.
Little by little, things began to change. There are always more possibilities than we expect. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
